summary: A Mississauga firm offering real estate, wills and notary services is a strength, but a 2023 footer and thin lawyer proof appear to cost you consultations.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read 2023, and the text 'Thanks for submitting!' appears as static text beside the form.
findings.cost: An old date and a premature success message make visitors doubt the form works.
findings.fix: A current footer and a message that shows only after submission.

findings.problem: The Wills and Estates link appears to point to /will-sestates, and the 'Use tab to navigate through the menu items' instruction appears visibly.
findings.cost: A mistyped link may send clients to an error page, and developer text looks unfinished.
findings.fix: Correct links and hidden helper text.

findings.problem: The services appear different in the intro and the menu (Family Law, Notary Public and Civil Litigation appear in one but not the other).
findings.cost: Mixed service lists confuse a client choosing a lawyer.

findings.problem: The main Book a Free Consultation button appears only near the bottom, and no testimonials, case results or lawyer bios appear.
findings.cost: Clients who do not scroll never see the call to action, and they have no proof to trust you.
findings.fix: A top of page consultation button and visible lawyer bios.

redesign: A current footer and working form message.
Correct links and one services list.
A top of page call to action and visible bios.
